corpusAttribution.note: Hole cards are masked at deal and revealed only at showdown. A folded hand therefore has no 169-cell attribution at any sample size. The revealed subset of entries is additionally selected toward hands that got called down, which biases it hardest in the fringe band the map exists to measure — so it is usable as a consistency check and not as the map's evidence.
